why_pinned_to_a_commit: A branch name moves under you. The commit sha fixes exactly these bytes.
why_the_version_moved: 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0. The PREVIOUS vendor (d6e17bec) also declared 1.2.0 while differing in behaviour, so an exact-version guard could not tell them apart. The Director ruled that a bundle whose behaviour changed needs a version that changed, and held this re-vendor until the source bumped it. This pin is the first one whose version actually moved.
